jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting-edge AI-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.

As trailblazers in end-to-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.

Our vision extends beyond mere problem-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Axion is looking for a Senior HR Business Partner to help shape the next chapter of our growth by building the foundational people infrastructure that will power our team through scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a builder who thrives in fast-moving, unstructured environments and is eager to design programs that don’t yet exist.

You’ll work directly with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, GTM, and Operations to establish core people systems and management practices—from the first formal performance review cycle to manager training, goal-setting, and feedback rituals. Your work will ensure our culture scales intentionally as our company grows.

This is an opportunity to make a lasting mark by creating the frameworks, processes, and leadership capabilities that define how Axion operates and leads.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Act as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders across Product, Engineering, GTM, and Operations, helping them navigate performance, feedback, and team development challenges.

 - Partner with the executive team to shape Axion’s long-term people strategy — advising on culture, engagement, retention, and leadership effectiveness.

 - Develop foundational people programs — including performance management, manager enablement, leveling frameworks, and feedback systems — to support scale.

 - Establish consistent management rhythms such as goal setting, 1:1 frameworks, and review cycles that drive accountability and growth.

 - Enhance end-to-end employee experience, from onboarding through offboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Axion’s values and culture.

 - Build scalable feedback loops and employee listening mechanisms (e.g., pulse surveys, stay interviews, exit feedback) that turn insight into action.

 - Develop playbooks, training content, and toolkits that strengthen manager capability and drive consistency across teams.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Recruiting, Finance, and Operations on workforce planning, compensation alignment, and organizational initiatives.

 - Use people data and qualitative insights to identify trends, flag leadership risks, and inform proactive retention and engagement strategies.
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience operating as a People Partner or HRBP supporting multiple departments or leadership teams within a high-growth, fast-changing environment.

 - Proven success building or formalizing people programs from scratch, such as performance reviews, leveling frameworks, or management training.

 - Strong track record of coaching managers through sensitive employee relations, performance, or organizational challenges. Demonstrated ability to drive clarity and structure in environments with little precedent or process.

 - Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Recruiting, Finance, and Operations on organizational design and compensation reviews.

 - Adept at using data and feedback to inform strategic people decisions and measure program effectiveness.
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Played a key role in helping a company scale from ~75 to 250+ employees.

 - Experience building or modernizing performance management, feedback, or promotion processes.

 - Exposure to technical and engineering teams, understanding their unique rhythms and leadership challenges.

 - Comfort operating as the first or only embedded HRBP in a scaling organization.

 - Based in NYC or open to working from our Williamsburg HQ at least 3 days/week.
   


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast-moving environments where people take ownership. You take pride in getting things done thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable moving between strategy and execution.

You value feedback in all directions and see collaboration as a competitive advantage. You’re low ego but high initiative: you care about collective success more than personal credit. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.

You’re proactive and create momentum when you see an opportunity. You care about doing things well and helping others do the same.



HOW WE OPERATE

We work with focus and intention, holding ourselves to a high bar while respecting the need for balance. Axion isn’t a traditional 9 to 5 job, but it’s also not a place that glorifies overwork. We take pride in the work, support each other through hard problems, and make space to recharge.

We’re a highly collaborative team that stays connected throughout the day, often over Slack. We share feedback freely, communicate clearly, and make decisions quickly so we can keep momentum without unnecessary meetings. If you value openness, iteration, and shared problem-solving, you’ll fit right in.



WE:

 - Collaborate deeply. Feedback is part of how we build; everyone has a voice, and ideas win on merit.

 - Leave ego at the door. Titles don’t define value—contribution does.

 - Bias toward action. We favor progress over perfection and learn as we go.

 - Communicate with clarity. Direct, transparent, and always in service of the mission.

 - Act like owners. Everyone is accountable for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - Aim for excellence sustainably. We challenge ourselves, support each other, and stay in it for the long game.
   

If you want to help shape a company redefining how manufacturing operates — and you thrive in a culture that rewards ownership, speed, and candor — you’ll feel at home here



WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Work with cutting-edge AI technology making a tangible impact in manufacturing

 - Collaborative, mission-driven team and supportive leadership

 - Generous time off

 - Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

 - Lunch stipend…. And much more


Ready to drive the future of manufacturing with AI? Apply today to join our team and help us build the category-defining platform for quality intelligence.

Axion is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
Axion | Solutions Organization

Axion helps the world's leading manufacturers identify, investigate, and resolve product quality issues before they become warranty claims, recalls, or customer disruptions. Axion is entering a new stage of scale: more of the world's leading manufacturers are starting deployments and moving from initial deployments to production, and Customer Success is becoming a core growth lever. We're hiring our first Head of Customer Success to turn exceptional customer outcomes into a repeatable operating system - and build the team that will scale it.

This is a true Head of / executive leadership role focused on building the team, systems, and operating model for Customer Success. You’ll define how we approach the customer lifecycle from onboarding and adoption through renewal and expansion, while establishing the metrics, health frameworks, segmentation, and playbooks that will allow the organization to scale.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BUILD IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

Your mission is to build the customer operating system that takes complex enterprise deployments from first value through adoption, executive value proof, production, and expansion - with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and a model Axion can scale.

During your first year, you'll:

 - Turn Axion's existing ability to create extraordinary customer outcomes through talented people and heroic effort into a repeatable customer-success machine.

 - Define one end-to-end customer lifecycle with explicit ownership and handoffs across Sales, Engagement, Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success

 - Establish the operating metrics and executive scorecard for activation, time-to-value, adoption, realized business value, retention, renewal forecasting, and expansion

 - Build customer segmentation, service tiers, coverage models, and operating rhythms that scale without reducing the quality of the customer experience

 - Build an early-warning customer health and risk system that gives teams and executives clear actions - not just scores

 - Create a repeatable executive value-realization motion - Mutual Success Plans, value readouts, and QBRs - that connects Axion usage to measurable business outcomes and commercial decisions

 - Create a predictable path from initial deployment to production and expansion, in close partnership with Sales

 - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing Customer Success organization that can scale alongside Axion's growth while maintaining a hands-on, player-coach culture

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

Axion already knows how to make customers wildly successful. The opportunity is to make that success systematic and scalable. You'll help define how some of the world's leading manufacturers adopt AI in production - not in a lab or a proof of concept, but in workflows tied to product quality, reliability, cost, and customer outcomes.

This is not a role where you'll inherit a mature Customer Success playbook and optimize around the edges. You'll work directly with Axion's leadership team to build the model: how we activate customers faster, prove measurable value, navigate complex enterprise deployments, retain and expand strategic accounts, and feed what we learn back into the product. The systems you build will become a core part of how Axion scales.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO


BUILD & SCALE CUSTOMER SUCCESS

 - Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing Customer Success organization as a hands-on player-coach

 - Codify a repeatable customer journey from onboarding and first value through production, renewal, and expansion

 - Design customer segmentation, service tiers, coverage models, playbooks, and operating rhythms that evolve with Axion's scale

 - Establish hiring standards, onboarding programs, and coaching frameworks for the Customer Success team


DRIVE CUSTOMER OUTCOMES

 - Personally partner with a small portfolio of Axion's most strategic enterprise customers; this role is expected to stay close to the work, not manage from a distance

 - Build trusted executive relationships that create conviction, accelerate adoption, and tie Axion to the customer's highest-priority business outcomes

 - Step into high-priority customer situations, diagnose what is blocking value, and mobilize the right cross-functional team to unblock them

 - Build a culture centered on measurable customer outcomes - business value realized, behaviors changed, and expansion earned - rather than activity


PARTNER ACROSS THE BUSINESS

 - Partner with Sales on account strategy, renewal, and expansion, with explicit ownership and handoffs across the customer lifecycle

 - Partner with Engagement and Solutions to make the transition from deployment to activation and value realization seamless

 - Turn patterns from customer deployments into crisp Product and Engineering priorities, while distinguishing scalable product needs from one-off requests

 - Create one integrated customer journey across Axion, so customers experience a single team rather than internal functions


BUILD OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Build a clear operating cadence around activation, time-to-value, customer health, adoption, realized value, renewals, retention, and expansion forecasting

 - Use customer data to identify risk, prioritize resources, and improve customer outcomes

 - Build the systems, tooling, automation, and executive reporting required to scale Customer Success with rigor

 
 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of Customer Success, Solutions, Services, or post-sale leadership experience in enterprise SaaS, AI, or other complex enterprise technology, including meaningful leadership responsibility

 - You've built and led high-performing enterprise Customer Success teams and can credibly operate as both an executive leader and a hands-on player-coach

 - Track record of moving complex enterprise customers from initial deployment to adoption, measurable business value, production or renewal, and expansion

 - Experience designing and scaling Customer Success organizations - including segmentation, lifecycle design, health, renewal forecasting, and playbooks - through a meaningful growth inflection, ideally from roughly $10-30M ARR through $50-100M+

 - Exceptional executive presence: you can build trust with Fortune 500 executives, technical leaders, and frontline operators - and move between those levels fluently

 - Systems thinker with strong operating rigor; you use data to diagnose problems, make tradeoffs, and drive accountability

 - Proven ability to define ownership and drive outcomes across Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and other customer-facing teams without relying on organizational boundaries

 - Experience in manufacturing, industrial technology, automotive, aerospace, or another complex operational environment is a strong plus, especially where software adoption changes real-world operations

 - Builder mentality: you thrive in ambiguity, prefer creating the playbook to inheriting one, and are energized by staying close to customers while scaling a team
